items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Even when he was about 17 and we were together... Roy was 17, I was 15 and Eddie was 13. And we were just kids, you know?

ctx.x: And Eddie told me a thing that -- when he was here -- that he had a thing to go to Singapore with the Chinese government, and Roy was always smart in that direction, you know. Even when he was about 17 and we were together, you know? And he made quite a success of himself, and he's got a good business head, and straight ahead, and his feet are still on the ground. In fact, Eddie was trying to get me to get a picture of us, because Roy wanted it, to use it for a TV show that they might make a special, on him. You…
